notes.title: Typo Fixes and FPS Limit Added
notes.content:
Fixed several typographical errors.
Added a limit to the maximum FPS, now capped at 120 FPS.

notes.title: Demo Save Data Can Now Be Carried Over
notes.content:
Notice
The demo has been updated, and save data can now be carried over directly into the full version of the game.
Important Note & Apology
Please note that save data from the demo before this update cannot be used to continue the story.

I apologize for the inconvenience and kindly ask that you use the skip feature or similar options to catch up.
